synthesis_inputs.neighbor_differences: Source location comments move after adding clearIndex in the shared rules object; neighboring module logic remains identical.

scope: Every supported pixel byte width repeats exact virtual clear bytes; 6656 highest-slot words, 227 masked updates, accepted-write cancellation and held replies are checked
Pixel/depth/stencil/blend and source/resolve transfer ownership retain exact bytes, invalid-input rejection, fault/cancel drain, per-sample depth, cached publication and lease progress
Actual local/global shared-CU prepared and native binned jobs retain indexed instances, four-sample images, independent engines, immutable contexts and exact healthy reuse
limitations: The new color pipeline is not yet qualified through the complete production AXI/Sv32 host; the native owner tests here use Bare mode
The separate GNX1 control extension is not included in this frozen source set; combined host/color/GNX1 validation remains necessary
The new synthesis run is still separate; no improved Fmax or new mapped area is established by functional tests or structural counts
No place-and-route, power, physical provenance, full Mobile runtime/rates/budgets or H0-H8 closure claim
